name: my-skill
tagline_zh: 新装技能不知通不通？一句话验证加载与响应。不折腾日志，不翻源码，像按一下开关就知道灯亮没亮。
tagline_en: One command to verify your skill loads and responds. No logs, no source—just a quick hello to test the system.
desc_en: A test skill that says hello. Use when you want to test skill loading or verify that the skill system is working.
why_zh: 同类工具要写测试用例，它只需一句问候。专为验证技能链路而生，简单到不可能出错。
why_en: Unlike test suites, it's a single hello that confirms the entire skill pipeline works—minimal and foolproof.
